task_summary: Elevated BukSU CMS-V2 manuscript evaluation pipeline into institutional-grade defense evaluation suite: 1) Embedded one-click '+ Add to ADM Directive' button in dual highlight popovers for exact plagiarism matches (>75%) and panel comments, auto-populating page numbers and remediation directives in the Action Done Matrix. 2) Built resilient multi-span and hyphenation normalizer in plagiarismHighlightAdapter.js stripping soft hyphens (\u00ad), zero-width spaces, collapsing line-end hyphens, and normalizing ligatures. 3) Added non-destructive layer opacity controls (15%-100%) via CSS custom properties (--comments-opacity, --plagiarism-opacity). 4) Created gutter margin split-pills with smooth-scroll anchors and focus rings. 5) Fixed React 18 infinite re-render loop on default array props in EvaluationWorkspace.jsx using EMPTY_ARRAY and prevAdmItemsRef. 6) Hardened comment.model.js Mongoose pre-hook across ['validate', 'save']. 7) Engineered @media print defense evaluation summary appendix with panel signature lines. Passed 30/30 client unit tests, 3/3 server model tests, 207/188 endpoint parity (UNMATCHED_COUNT=0), 60/60 agentic validation checks, pristine workspace guardrails, and 11-point Playwright visual audit across desktop and mobile in light and dark themes.

lessons_learned.context: React 18 renders re-evaluate default array parameters (e.g. admItems = []) as new object references on every render pass. When bound to useEffect dependencies, this triggers an infinite state update loop. Declare Object.freeze([]) as an immutable module constant and track genuine reference changes with useRef.

Academic manuscripts frequently break terms across dual-column line wraps with hard hyphens or unicode soft hyphens (\u00ad). Normalizing typography (collapsing /(\w+)-\s*\r?\n\s*(\w+)/g to $1$2 and unfolding ligatures) before computing getTextPosition is required for reliable PDF text layer coordinate resolution.

Non-destructive layer opacity adjustments must drive CSS custom properties on container wrappers (--comments-opacity, --plagiarism-opacity) rather than modifying highlight objects or React state per highlight, preventing expensive re-renders and canvas redraws.
For institutional print defense compliance, hide interactive UI bars with print:hidden and render an un-truncated Action Done Matrix table and Committee Sign-off blocks using hidden print:block.
